_comment: Max allowed occurrences of backend words (sglang|hicache|radix) in identifiers/non-docstring strings of portable packages. These are recorded artifact keys, CLI mode names or external-tool defaults that cannot be renamed without migrating reports. The count may only go DOWN. See docs/architecture/README_RESTRUCTURING.md#vocabulary-allowlist.

reasons.aiconfigurator_estimator.py: backend='sglang' is the default model family passed to the external aiconfigurator estimator, plus the sglang_cached_tokens input column
reasons.eviction_value.py: output keys controller_sglang_priority / controller_eviction_policy='sglang_radix_priority_eviction' are recorded artifact columns
reasons.lead_times.py: error message names the SGLang/HiCache prepare-prefix control path
reasons.modes.py: experiment mode names storage_hicache_* are CLI/report identifiers
reasons.translation.py: meta keys controller_sglang_priority and cache-lowering keys sglang_cache_salt are recorded artifact columns
reasons.signals.py: reads legacy meta keys controller_sglang_priority / sglang_priority
reasons.controller_signal.py: reads the legacy sglang_priority meta key
